 Election 2026: Through the Eyes of Montclair State University Students 
 Montclair State University photojournalism students capture the 2026 election season across New Jersey, from campaign rallies and polling places to election-night celebrations. 
 by 
 Montclair State University and Montclair Local 
 November 9, 2026 November 9, 2026

 From campaign rallies and conversations with voters to polling places and election-night celebrations, Montclair State University photojournalism students captured the people and moments of the 2026 election season across New Jersey.
 Continuing our collaboration with Montclair State University’s Introduction to Photojournalism class, led by Associate Professor  Thomas Franklin  in the College of Communication and Media, Montclair Local presents a selection of the students’ work.

 Through their lenses, these photographs offer a look at democracy in action, from the campaign trail to Election Day.
 LAWRENCEVILLE, N.J., Oct. 8, 2026 — Democratic supporters hold signs outside Rider University’s Bart Luedeke Center as Democratic incumbent U.S. Sen. Cory Booker debates Republican challenger Justin Murphy. The debate was hosted by the New Jersey Globe and Rider University. Photo by Silvia Andrade/Montclair State University. 
 LAWRENCEVILLE, N.J., Oct. 8, 2026 — Democratic incumbent U.S. Sen. Cory Booker debates Republican challenger Justin Murphy at Rider University’s Bart Luedeke Center. The New Jersey Globe and Rider University hosted the debate. Photo by Rhamses Sarmiento/Montclair State University. 
 NEPTUNE, N.J., Oct. 24, 2026 — Montclair State University student Gwenyth Greenspan, center, poses with U.S. Sen. Cory Booker and another student during a Democratic rally. Photo courtesy of Gwenyth Greenspan/Montclair State University 
 EAST ORANGE, N.J., Nov. 1, 2026 — Gov. Mikie Sherrill stands with Democratic supporters at Essex County’s Countywide Day of Action event. Photo by Kaitlin Swift/Montclair State University. 
 EAST ORANGE, N.J., Nov. 1, 2026 — U.S. Rep. Analilia Mejia , who represents New Jersey’s 11th Congressional District, speaks to East Orange residents at a Countywide Day of Action event ahead of the midterm election. Photo by Kaitlin Swift/Montclair State University. 
 CLIFTON, N.J., Nov. 1, 2026 — Gov. Mikie Sherrill hugs U.S. Rep. Nellie Pou during the Passaic County Democrats’ get-out-the-vote rally at the Clifton Elks Lodge. Photo by Kleon Prelvukaj/Montclair State University. 
 LINDEN, N.J., Nov. 1, 2026 — U.S. Sen. Cory Booker steps off the stage to speak among audience members at a get-out-the-vote rally. Booker opened his remarks by recalling New Jerseyans, including suffragist Alice Paul, who turned frustration into political change. Photo by Allen Macaraeg/Montclair State University. 
 LINDEN, N.J., Nov. 1, 2026 — Audience members cheer as Brianna Armstead, the Democratic candidate for Linden’s Fourth Ward council seat, addresses the crowd. Photo by Allen Macaraeg/Montclair State University. 
 EAST ORANGE, N.J., Nov. 1, 2026 — Democratic U.S. Rep. Rob Menendez speaks at Essex County’s Countywide Day of Action rally to encourage supporters to vote early. Gov. Mikie Sherrill also attended. Photo by Jazmin Mendoza/Montclair State University. 
 EAST ORANGE, NJ. 11-01-2026: COUNTYWIDE DAY OF ACTION: Democratic supporters listen to Gov. Mikie Sherrill speak at Essex County’s Countywide Day of Action rally, encouraging supporters to vote and help turn out voters ahead of Election Day. Photo by Jazmin Mendoza/Montclair State University. 
 EAST ORANGE, N.J., Nov. 1, 2026 — Essex County Democratic Committee Chairman Leroy J. Jones shares a hug with an attendee during a rally to energize supporters ahead of Election Day. Gov. Mikie Sherrill also attended. Photo by Jazmin Mendoza/Montclair State University. 
 BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Nov. 3, 2026 — An attendee wears a red shirt displaying a political message during Democrat Rebecca Bennett’s election-night watch party at Bridgewater Manor. Photo by Kyra Washington/Montclair State University. 
 BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Nov. 3, 2026 — Democratic candidate Rebecca Bennett celebrates onstage with her husband, Alex Hydrean, and daughters, Rosie and Millie, after defeating Tom Kean Jr. in New Jersey’s 7th Congressional District race. Photo by Kyra Washington/Montclair State University. 
 BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Nov. 3, 2026 — Montclair State student Kyra Washington covers Democrat Rebecca Bennett’s election-night watch party at Bridgewater Manor. Photo Courtesy Kyra Washington/Montclair State University. 
 UNION CITY, N.J., Nov. 3, 2026 — Margarita Martinez and Esmerelda Capulin pose for a portrait after casting their ballots at the Union City Daycare polling location on Election Day. Photo by Logan Connolly/Montclair State University. 
 SECAUCUS, N.J., Nov. 3, 2026 — Voters leave the polling location at Huber Street School after casting their ballots on Election Day. Photo by Logan Connolly/Montclair State University. 
 HACKENSACK, N.J., Nov. 3, 2026 — Donna West smiles outside Nellie K. Parker Elementary School after helping voters on Election Day. “It makes me feel so happy to see everyone come out to vote for our community,” West said. Photo by Blair Drakeford/Montclair State University.
